frequency_main_effect.spacing_rule: interior knots equally spaced in log f

location_main_effect.rbf_center_method: deterministic k-medoids on standardized sensor coordinates (per-axis mean 0 / sd 1); coordinates only
location_main_effect.rbf_scale_rule: median nonzero pairwise distance between centers

interaction.form: tensor product of the frequency basis with the location basis
interaction.explicitly_excluded: channel identity — a per-channel random effect has ZERO predictive mean at an unseen channel and may not be credited as spatial transfer

constraints.main_effects: weighted mean zero within each training drive, per main-effect block
constraints.interaction: zero weighted frequency margin AND zero weighted location margin
constraints.rank_deficiency: deterministic SVD tolerance 1e-08 on column-normalised blocks, columns kept left-to-right
constraints.note: a single grand sum-to-zero constraint is explicitly NOT sufficient and is not used

coefficient_prior.Lambda_beta_rule: per-block variance = (target dB scale / 20*log10(e))^2 with target 6 dB for main effects and 3 dB for interactions; frozen here, never tuned on held-out responses

channel_variation: handled by a per-channel nugget in the covariance, never by a mean column
